title.en: List the gRPC calls in the capture
title.hinglish: Capture mein gRPC calls list karo

why.en: Wireshark decodes gRPC on top of HTTP/2 and shows the message and its protobuf fields.
why.hinglish: Wireshark HTTP/2 ke upar gRPC decode karta hai aur message aur uske protobuf fields dikhata hai.

expect.en: The request and response messages, with the path /weather.Weather/GetForecast and the protobuf fields. The capture is plain HTTP/2 on port 50051; you may need Analyze, Decode As, HTTP2 for that port.
expect.hinglish: Request aur response messages, path /weather.Weather/GetForecast aur protobuf fields ke saath. Capture port 50051 par plain HTTP/2 hai; us port ke liye shayad Analyze, Decode As, HTTP2 karna pade.

title.en: Find the result in the trailers

why.en: The real outcome of a call is the grpc-status header sent at the end.
why.hinglish: Call ka asli outcome end mein bheja gaya grpc-status header hai.

expect.en: A HEADERS frame with grpc-status: 0 in the normal scenario, and grpc-status: 4 in the deadline scenario.
expect.hinglish: Normal scenario mein grpc-status: 0 wala HEADERS frame, aur deadline scenario mein grpc-status: 4.

title.en: See that gRPC is just HTTP/2 over TLS
title.hinglish: Dekho ki gRPC bas TLS par HTTP/2 hai

why.en: Many Google APIs speak gRPC on port 443, so you can check that they negotiate h2.
why.hinglish: Bahut si Google APIs port 443 par gRPC bolti hain, isliye tum check kar sakte ho ki ve h2 negotiate karti hain.

expect.en: Prints 2 (or 3 if your curl prefers HTTP/3). gRPC needs HTTP/2, so any gRPC endpoint negotiates h2 through ALPN.
expect.hinglish: 2 print hota hai (ya 3 agar tumhara curl HTTP/3 prefer kare). gRPC ko HTTP/2 chahiye, isliye har gRPC endpoint ALPN se h2 negotiate karta hai.
